description.value: NongGengji is a global chain restaurant specializing in authentic Hunan cuisine, founded in 2017 by Chinese culinary master Feng Guohua and now operating over 100 direct stores across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and beyond. The Richmond location is one of the brand's North American outposts, bringing fiery, ingredient-forward Hunan cooking to a sit-down dining room in the Aberdeen area. Touring cyclists will find it a substantial meal stop on the busy Number 3 Road corridor.
